proposed_widenings.name: PolymorphFormSource.known_forms_roster
proposed_widenings.justification: Wild Shape does not pick from any Beast matching a generic CR bound at use time; it picks from the druid's learned Beast forms for this feature. The existing transform source only supports broad catalog refs, not a caller-owned learned roster.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you shape-shift into a Beast form that you have learned for this feature"

proposed_widenings.name: DurationValue.class_scaled_hours
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing class-feature duration field can express fixed timed durations, but not a duration measured in hours equal to half class level.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You stay in that form for a number of hours equal to half your Druid level"

proposed_widenings.name: transform_target.actionRestriction.no_spellcasting
proposed_widenings.justification: The current transform restriction only encodes "no_speech_no_spells". Wild Shape explicitly preserves speech while forbidding spellcasting, so the existing restriction would be false.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you retain ... ability to speak" and "You can't cast spells"

proposed_widenings.name: PolymorphRetainedField.class_features_feats_save_proficiencies
proposed_widenings.justification: Wild Shape preserves more character-side state than the current retained-field vocabulary can represent honestly, including class features, feats, and saving throw proficiencies.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you retain your ... class features; languages; and feats. You also retain your skill and saving throw proficiencies"

proposed_widenings.name: PolymorphRevertTrigger.use_again_or_incapacitated_or_die
proposed_widenings.justification: The current revert trigger set does not cover Wild Shape ending when reused, when the druid becomes Incapacitated, or when the druid dies.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "until you use Wild Shape again, have the Incapacitated condition, or die"

notes: Existing class_feature activation and transform_target machinery are close, so this is narrower than structural_widening. I did not author content/druid_wild_shape_l2.dhall because any current encoding would lie about at least the form source, duration scaling, or speech-vs-spellcasting rule.
